topic: Kaido was waiting for Joy Boy to beat him, so Luffy's win in 1049 pays off his own words
title: Kaido Was Waiting For Joy Boy To Beat Him
description: Kaido spent years trying to die and told King that Joy Boy would be the one to beat him. Here's why his loss to Luffy in chapter 1049 was set up long before Gear 5. Do you buy it?
comment: Did Kaido lose to Luffy, or did he lose to Joy Boy? Pick one.

lines.text: Kaido didn't lose to Luffy. I think he lost to Joy Boy, and he knew it.

shot.fallback: giant dragon facing a rubber hero

lines.text: Look at what he actually says before the end.

shot.fallback: armored warrior and a giant oni

lines.text: In chapter 1049, Kaido remembers telling King that Joy Boy would be the one to beat him.
Not a pirate. Not a Marine. Joy Boy.

shot.fallback: laughing sun god warrior in white

lines.text: Now rewind to chapter 1044, when Luffy awakens.

shot.fallback: white haired hero laughing in the sky

lines.text: Kaido's glad Luffy is still alive.
Remember, this is the man who tried to end his own life again and again.
He wasn't hunting the strongest fighter, he was hunting an ending.

shot.search: Kaido wants to die strongest creature
shot.fallback: giant oni on a cliff at dusk

lines.text: People say Gear 5 just out-powered him.

shot.fallback: huge rubber fist striking a dragon

lines.text: Sure, the Bajrang Gun hit like a mountain.
But a man who wanted to die wasn't beaten by a stronger punch alone.
He was beaten by the one person he'd been waiting for.

shot.fallback: giant dragon facing a rubber hero

self_check.hook: Kaido lost to Joy Boy claim in line 1
